annotations.title: Check whether an address can be mailed

description: Answer "can I actually send to this address?" before writing or debugging a send path. Checks BOTH gates the send pipeline applies, because they are separate records and checking only one gives a confidently wrong answer: a SUPPRESSION record (hard bounce, complaint, unsubscribe, manual block) stops every send including transactional, and a CONTACT marked unsubscribed separately stops marketing-type sends only. An address with a clean suppression list is still skipped as "unsubscribed" if its contact opted out. Returns which gate would close and why. Read-only — it never suppresses, unsubscribes, or creates anything.

email.description: Recipient address to check. Case and surrounding space are normalized.

name: volanea_check_recipient

code.description: Machine-readable failure code to branch on. Present only when success is false.

blockedBy.description: Which gate would close: suppression, unsubscribed, or null.

canSendMarketing.description: False when suppressed OR the contact unsubscribed — two separate records.

canSendTransactional.description: False when a suppression blocks every send type.

email.description: Normalized form of the address checked.

suppression.description: The suppression record and its reason, when one exists.

verdict.description: Plain-language explanation, including project-wide blocks this tool does not check.

error.description: Human-readable failure reason. Present only when success is false.

success.description: False when the call failed; read `error` and `code` in that case.
